title: Task-Aligned Stability Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving Hazard Detection
abstract: arXiv:2606.11889v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for scene understanding in autonomous driving, but robustness analysis often relies on task-agnostic embedding stability alone. We study whether corruption-induced embedding drift predicts changes in a task-aligned hazard score derived from CLIP image-text similarities. Using controlled corruptions on BDD100K road scenes, we compare embedding drift against margin drift, defined as the change in hazard score under perturbation. The relationship is highly corruption-dependent: some families exhibit strong coupling between representation drift and decision drift, while others induce hazardous decision instability despite relatively modest embedding change. translated_title: 面向自动驾驶危险检测的视觉-语言模型任务对齐稳定性分析
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在自动驾驶场景理解中的应用日益广泛，但现有的鲁棒性分析通常仅依赖于与任务无关的嵌入稳定性。我们研究了由损坏扰动引起的嵌入漂移能否预测基于CLIP图文相似度得出的任务对齐危险评分的变化。通过在BDD100K道路场景上进行受控损坏实验，我们将嵌入漂移与边际漂移（即扰动下危险评分的变化量）进行对比。结果显示，二者的关系高度依赖于损坏类型：某些损坏类别在表征漂移与决策漂移之间表现出强耦合，而另一些类别则在嵌入变化相对较小的情况下仍引发危险的决策不稳定性。此外，不同损坏类别的失败方向也存在差异：大多数损坏通过假阴性抑制危险检测，而遮挡反而触发误报，这表明基准测试的设计应当考虑这种不对称的失败模式。
tldr: 该论文发现嵌入漂移对自动驾驶危险评分变化的预测能力高度依赖损坏类型——不同损坏在表征漂移与决策漂移的耦合程度以及失败方向（假阴性vs误报）上呈现显著不对称性，提示鲁棒性评估应超越任务无关的嵌入稳定性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that embedding drift's ability to predict task-aligned hazard score changes is highly corruption-dependent, with asymmetric failure directions across corruption families (false negatives vs. false alarms), suggesting robustness benchmarks for autonomous driving should go beyond task-agnostic embedding stability.
